title: Service Standards for Laboratory Test Orders: Turnaround, Report Copies and Corrections
content:
The service standards below are set per service class of Laboratory Test Orders. Business days run Monday to Friday, excluding federal holidays.

| Service class | Standard turnaround, accession to final report (business days) | Report copy sent within (business days) | Mailed paper copy fee (USD) | Corrected report issued within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | 1 | 2 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | 3 | 2 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | 6 | 2 | 0.00 | 2 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | 2 | 2 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | 4 | 2 | 0.00 | 2 |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | 4 | 2 | 0.00 | 2 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 18 | 3 | 0.00 | 3 |

## Column notes

- **Standard turnaround** — the business days from accession to final report for the class.
- **Report copy sent within** — the business days within which a patient's request for a copy of a final report is fulfilled.
- **Mailed paper copy fee** — the fee for a mailed paper copy of a report. Portal and provider copies are free. The fee is 0.00 for every class, so a mailed paper copy is also free of charge.
- **Corrected report issued within** — the business days within which a corrected report is issued once the laboratory confirms an error.

## Comparisons

- Routine Clinical Testing has the shortest turnaround (1 business day) and Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing the longest (18 business days).
- Copies are sent within 2 business days in every class except Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing, which takes 3.
